description.value: Dremio is an open, high-performance data lakehouse platform built to accelerate AI and analytical workloads.
Dremio sells an open data lakehouse platform for AI and analytics.
Dremio is a data lakehouse company founded in 2015 and based in Santa Clara, California.

product_description.value: Combines an Intelligent Query Engine, AI Semantic Layer, Open Catalog powered by Apache Polaris, and a built-in AI agent.
Dremio Cloud (fully managed), Dremio Enterprise (self-managed software) and a free Dremio Community Edition, built on Apache Iceberg, Apache Polaris and Apache Arrow.
Core offering is a SQL query engine that runs alongside other processing tools on the same data, adding Git-like version control and governance.

business_model_description.value: Available as a fully managed cloud service or self-managed software, with a free trial of $400 in credits and no credit card required.
Business model is a combination of subscription and usage-based pricing; one profile calls it a B2B SaaS company.

customer_description.value: Trusted by thousands of companies across all industries; named case studies include Amazon, Shell, Maersk, E.ON and RWE.
Named case studies include Amazon, Shell, Maersk, E.ON and RWE; logos include Garmin, Farmers, Capital Group, Moody's and Enel.
Target clients are generally medium to large enterprises; the snippet cites JPMorgan Chase, Microsoft, Regeneron and Allianz Global Investors.

headquarters.value: Mountain View, CA (Built In); its location field lists Santa Clara
